# USIU-Africa Academic Programs for 2023-2024

USIU-Africa offers a diverse range of undergraduate and graduate programs across multiple schools and disciplines for the current academic year. Here's a comprehensive overview:

## Undergraduate Programs

### School of Business and Management
- Bachelor of Science in Accounting
- Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
- Bachelor of Science in Finance
- Bachelor of Science in Human Resource Management
- Bachelor of Science in International Business Administration
- Bachelor of Science in Marketing

### School of Communication, Cinematic and Creative Arts
- Bachelor of Arts in Animation
- Bachelor of Arts in Communication
- Bachelor of Arts in Film Production and Directing
- Bachelor of Arts in Journalism

### School of Humanities and Social Sciences
- Bachelor of Arts in International Relations
- Bachelor of Arts in Psychology
- Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice
- Bachelor of Science in International Relations

### School of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
- Bachelor of Pharmacy
- Bachelor of Science in Epidemiology and Biostatistics

### School of Science and Technology
- Bachelor of Science in Applied Computer Technology
- Bachelor of Science in Information Systems and Technology

## Graduate Programs

### School of Business and Management
- Master of Business Administration (MBA)
- Executive MBA
- Global Executive MBA
- Master of Science in Management and Organizational Development

### School of Communication, Cinematic and Creative Arts
- Master of Arts in Communication Studies

### School of Humanities and Social Sciences
- Master of Arts in Clinical Psychology
- Master of Arts in Counseling Psychology
- Master of Arts in International Relations
- Master of Arts in Marriage and Family Therapy

### School of Graduate Studies, Research and Extension
- Doctor of Business Administration (DBA)
- Doctor of Philosophy in International Relations
- Doctor of Psychology (PsyD)

## Professional Certifications
- Various professional development courses and certificates across disciplines

Please note that specific course offerings within these programs may vary by semester. For the most up-to-date information on course schedules, prerequisites, and availability, I recommend checking the official USIU-Africa academic catalog or contacting the admissions office directly.
